0.zh: 2. 关于 1811/12 学年的文科中学报告110)

en: (Extract)
zh: （节录）

en: The organization of the institution is calculated for a course of ten years of life; of these, four years fall to the primary schools, two to the preparatory school and four to the gymnasium.

Insofar, however, as the local institution has not only primary schools but also a collaborature class - whose two divisions, the Lorenzer and the Sebalder class, stand on an equal footing -, the lower four years are divided between these preparatory classes and the primary schools.

For the collaborature classes are indeed to be regarded only in part as preparatory schools for the lower primary school, for their instruction extends far beyond those pieces of knowledge and skills which the normative regulation lays down as the condition for entry into the latter: in Latin not only the technique of declensions and conjugations is taught, but the whole doctrine of the parts of speech is worked through, advanced to the rules of syntax, and the same practised through oral and written translations.

For pupils of talent, attention and diligence, therefore, these preparatory classes stand on a par with the lower primary schools, and it becomes possible to be promoted from them directly into the upper primary class; as indeed in this year of study two pupils from each were again transferred thither.

That preparation has a further effect upon the lower primary school, so that through it the latter is raised in status and can be regarded as the first course of the upper primary school; hence as a rule a pupil who does not belong to the outstanding ones has to stay only one year in each of those two schools after completing the course in the collaborature class; but it must be noted that the course in the collaborature class can take two years for the slower ones, and, as a trial before one gives a pupil up entirely, three years as well.

This arrangement does indeed make it possible that a pupil who enters the institution only a little later than the normal age requires, by quickly making up what he has missed, can still reach the class corresponding to his years and complete his course in the institution in good time; but he who has missed his instruction in the earlier years of life and has begun it considerably too late is inevitably left behind.

Since I have before me several older instances, and again, in the admission just made of new pupils for the next course, fresh examples of this lateness, I repeat at this opportunity the exhortation to parents and guardians to hold their children and wards to beginning early enough - whether in the gymnasium itself or by private arrangement - to learn the first elements of those knowledge which are required for study in general or at least in order to be able to have a share in a part of the gymnasium training.
zh: 本校的组织是以十年的学程为计算基准的：其中四年归初级学校，两年归预科中学，四年归文科中学。
不过，就本地机构除初级学校之外还设有一个协作班而言——该班的两个分部，即洛伦策班与塞巴尔德班，彼此平等——，这最初的四年便在这些预备班与初级学校之间分配。
因为协作班只有一部分才可视为下级初级学校的预备学校；它们的教学远远超出作为进入后者之规章条件的那部分知识与技能：在拉丁文课上，不仅教授变格与变位的技法，而且把词类的全部学说整个做完，进而推进到句法的规则，并通过口头与书面的翻译加以操练。
因此，对于有才能、专注而勤勉的学生，这些预备班与下级初级学校是并行的，从它们直接升入初级最高班也就成为可能；事实上在本学年中，每班又有两名学生被调往那里。
这种预备此外还作用于下级初级学校，使后者因此被提高了地位，可以看作上级初级学校的第一个课程；所以通常一个并非属于出类拔萃之列的学生，在协作班读满课程之后，在那两所学校中每所只需停留一年；但须注意的是，协作班的课程对于进度较慢者可能要两年，作为在完全放弃某个学生之前的尝试，甚至可能三年。
这一设置固然使这样的学生有可能：只要入学比正常年龄所要求的稍晚一些，仍能通过迅速补上所缺而进入与自己年龄相应的班级，并在恰当时期完成他在校内的课程；然而，那些在更早的岁月里耽误了学业、起步已大为过晚的学生，则必然落后。
由于我手头有若干较年长的实例，而在刚刚为下一课程录取新学生时又有新鲜的这类迟误实例，我借此机会再一次向父母与监护人呼吁：务必要早早地敦促自己的孩子与被监护人——无论是在文科中学里，还是通过私人安排——去学习那些知识的初级原理，这些知识对于求学本身、或者至少为了能够参与文科中学教养的一部分来说，都是必需的。

en: The most important aspect that comes into consideration here is the great extent of knowledge and skills which he who devotes himself to the study of the sciences has to acquire.

In itself one does not perceive this extent as it actually is; the progress becomes imperceptible through its gradualness, the manifold stages and parts of knowledge and skill push into one another, and memory does not hold them apart as they were distinguished in the actual acquisition: so that generally the result of all that one has learned [and] also - allowing for what has really been forgotten - retained, appears in the representation far smaller than it actually is. - The different classes of an institution, on the other hand, mark these stages in their determinate difference, and a survey of them gives a detailed representation of the great extent of what is to be learned.

Learning further does not consist in becoming familiar with something and learning it by heart; that is by far the least of it; in order to hold a piece of knowledge within us, we must keep it forever firmly and securely in memory and be able to make it present to us in every context.
For that end it must have passed through our head numberless times.

Public institutions of instruction have in this respect an essential advantage over private tuition; they have - leaving other circumstances aside - the psychological advantage that, because of the number of pupils, the same thing must be repeated numberless times, the teacher inquiring whether this one and that one has retained it as well, and saying it once more to the inattentive - a repetition which on the one hand, because it has a rational ground and is associated with alternating individual circumstances, does not produce even for those who know the thing that disgust and boredom which must be the consequence of the same repetition in private tuition, where one has only one or a few pupils before one; while this more frequent hearing on the other hand is also essential for the more attentive to a sure and indelible acquaintance with the matter.

Experience therefore usually shows that even if young people know many things through private tuition, their acquaintance with them has less firmness and security than that of those who have learned the same in public schools.
zh: 这里首先要考虑的最重要的一面，是那些献身于学问研究的人必须获得的知识与技能的巨大范围。
就其本身而言，人们对这个范围的感受并不如它实际的样子那样；进展因其渐进而难以察觉，知识与技能的诸多阶段和部分彼此推移交叠，记忆也不把它们像实际获取时那样区分开来：因此，一个人所学到的、以及即使扣除真正忘掉的部分之后所保留下来的东西的总成果，在表象中通常显得远小于它实际的样子。——而一所机构的各个班级则以其确定的差别标示出这些阶段，对它们的概览则给出所要学习之宏大范围的细致表象。
此外，学习并不在于对某物有所知晓并把它背熟——那远非学习的全部；为要把一项知识真正据为己有，我们必须把它牢牢而稳固地保存在记忆中，并且能在任何关联之中把它召回到我们面前。
为此，它就必须无数次地从我们头脑中走过。

在这一方面，公立教学机构相对于私人授课有着本质上的优势：撇开别的情形不谈，它们在心理上占便宜——由于学生众多，同一件事不得不被重复无数次：教师要问这一位、那一位是否也把它记住了，并对那些不加注意的学生再讲一遍。这种重复一方面因为有一个合理的理由，并且与各人不同的个别情形相结合，所以对于已经知道这件事的人也不会产生在私人授课中必然产生的那种腻烦与无聊——在私人授课中，你面前只有一个或几个学生；另一方面，这种更频繁的听讲对于较认真的学生来说，也是获得对该事物稳固而不磨灭的认识所必需的。
因此经验通常表明：年轻人即使通过私人授课知道许多东西，他们对此的熟悉程度也比不上在公立学校学到同样东西的人那样稳固可靠。

en: The actual skills, the application of general knowledge and rules in practice, require an even more manifold and longer exercise.

Here it is therefore a matter of perceiving, in the case that arises, the point of view which calls up a rule; for every case is a concrete thing, a union of manifold points of view, all of which want to be observed in particular and to have their right in common with the rest.
The many-sided skill which this side, especially the knowledge of language, requires is acquired above all through written exercises.
How important this means is has been proved with decided success through the experience made in the institution.

It presupposes a quite different and deeper kind of possession if we are also to express what we know in writing and to bring the general knowledge into application; just as this active, productive behaviour requires a far more intimate occupation of the head than reading and hearing, where we receive everything ready-made.

In no exercise does the reflective head, truly destined for study, prove itself so well as in this one. - Since a large part of the written exercises has to be prepared by the pupils at home, these tasks give them the main material for their private diligence and the guidance for the most useful employment of the time free from school.

On the other hand, the inspection, which likewise takes place at home by the teachers, considerably increases the work of their office and takes away the greater part of their free hours, so that - since most tasks of this kind occur in the lower classes - hardly any time is left them which they would have to devote to the earning of the supplement to their salary, so as to gain what is requisite for the indispensable maintenance of life.
zh: 真正需要技能、需要把一般知识与规则付诸运用，则要有更加多样而持久的练习。
这里所关的，正在于在具体出现的个案中把握住那个召来某条规则的着眼点；因为每一个个案都是一个具体之物，是诸多着眼点的结合，而它们都要求各自被特别地观察，并与其余诸点共同享有自身的权利。
这一方面——尤其是语言知识——所需要的多方面技能，主要是通过书面练习获得的。
这一手段何等重要，已通过在本校获得的经验以决定性的成效得到印证。
如果我们还要把所知的东西书写出来并把一般知识付诸运用，那就预设了一种完全不同、也更深层的占有方式；因为这种自主的、创造性的行为要求头脑有远比阅读与聆听更为内在的专注，而在阅读与聆听中我们只是把一切都现成地接受下来。
在没有任何一种练习中，那善于思考、真正注定用于求学的头脑，像在这项练习中这样得到检验。——由于书面练习中有很大一部分必须由学生在家完成，这些作业便为他们提供了私下勤勉的主要材料，也提供了对他们在校余时间的最有益的使用的指导。
另一方面，教师同样在家进行的批阅大大增加了他们职务上的工作量，并且占去了他们大部分的空闲时间，以致——由于这类作业大多出现在低年级——他们几乎没有余下的时间可用在赚取工资补贴上，好去取得维持不可或缺的生计所必需的东西。

en: Gymnasium instruction, in that it imposes so many home tasks on the pupils, thereby does its part, over and above the direct moral and religious instruction and direct exhortations, to keep the young men from distractions and diversions by occupying the time they have free from public lessons.

The teachers must count here both on the support of the parents, that the children are kept at home to diligence and orderly occupation, and above all on the fact that domestic discipline and supervision watch over their conduct and preserve their morals.

What good is it if the young people are indeed well instructed in knowledge and the sciences, but if the parents and guardians, through neglecting either their own supervision or the proper arrangement for it - if they do not live at the place of study themselves, [neglecting it] with the house- and boarding-masters - let the moral character of their sons go to ruin?

But they can promise themselves no progress in the sciences either from such sons or wards; how can instruction win a thriving in young men whose soul is occupied by the craving for distractions and diversions, by the habit of idleness and an undisciplined way of life, and by the imagining of their freedom and emancipation connected therewith?
zh: 文科中学的教学由于给学生布置如此之多的家庭作业，也就尽到了自己的一份责任：除了直接的道德与宗教教育以及直接的告诫之外，还要用那些从公共课堂中空出来的时间安排事情，把青年们从消遣与放荡中拉住。
教师在这里既指望得到父母方面的支持，使孩子们在家中被督促于勤勉与有秩序的操练；尤其也指望家庭的训育与监督看守着他们的举止、保存着他们的习俗。
这又有什么用呢：青年即便在知识与学问上得到了良好的教导，而父母与监护人却因疏于——或是疏于自己的监督，或是疏于作出应有的安排：倘若他们本人不住在求学之地，那就是疏于同房东及寄膳主人之间的安排——而让自己儿子的伦理品格败坏下去。
然而他们也不能指望从这样的儿子或被监护人身上得到学问上的长进：那些青年既然的心灵已被对消遣与放荡的渴求、被无所事事的习惯与不受约束的生活方式、以及被与此相连的关于自身自由与解放的想象所占据，教学又怎能使他们在其中获得成长呢？

6.en: 3. On the Delivery of Philosophy in Gymnasia
6.zh: 3. 论在文科中学讲授哲学

en: Private opinion for the Royal Bavarian Oberschulrat Immanuel Niethammer111) (1812)
zh: 呈巴伐利亚王国督学伊曼努尔·尼特哈默阁下的私人鉴定书111)（1812）

en: Nuremberg, 23.
October
zh: 纽伦堡，23. 日

en: The delivery of the philosophical preparatory sciences in the gymnasium presents two aspects:
zh: 在文科中学里讲授哲学预备学科，有两个方面：

en: I. the subjects of instruction themselves, II. the method.
zh: I. 教学科目本身，II. 方法。

en: As regards I., the subjects of instruction together with their distribution among the three classes, the regulations set down the following on this point:
zh: 至于 I. 教学科目及其在三个年级之间的分配，规章就此规定如下：

en: For the lower class, religious, juridical and ethical knowledge is appointed (III, § 5 III).
zh: 低年级规定的是（III，§ 5 III）宗教、法权与义务方面的知识。

en: Against this, VC is given to the effect that in the lower class the beginning of the exercise of speculative thinking can be made with logic.
zh: 与此相对，VC 中写明：在低年级可以以逻辑学作为思辨思维训练的开端。

en: For the middle class: a) Cosmology, natural theology, in connection with the Kantian critiques. b) Psychology.
zh: 中年级：a) 宇宙论、自然神学，与康德的诸种批判相联结。b) 心理学。

en: For the upper class: philosophical encyclopedia.
zh: 高年级：哲学百科全书。

en: Since, with regard to the lower class, the delivery of the doctrine of right, of duties and of religion cannot well be reconciled with that of logic, I have hitherto proceeded in this way: that in the lower class I treated only the doctrine of right, of duties and of religion, but reserved logic for the middle class, and delivered it there alternately with psychology - that class having a two-year course.
Then the prescribed encyclopedia fell to the upper class.
zh: 由于就低年级而言，法权学说、义务论与宗教学说的讲授与逻辑学不能很好地相协调，我迄今的处理是：在低年级只讲授法权学说、义务论与宗教学说，而把逻辑学留到中年级去讲，并且在这门两年制课程的这个年级里与心理学交替讲授。
这样，规定的百科全书就落到了高年级。

en: If I am to give my general judgment on the whole distribution, both according to the matter itself and according to my experience, I can only declare that I have found it very appropriate.
zh: 如果我要就整个分配给出我的一般判断——既依据事情本身，也依据我的经验——那我只能声明：我认为它非常切合实际。

en: To enter into the particulars of this, 1. with regard to the first subject of instruction, the expression “doctrine of religion, right and duty” is used in the regulations, in which lies the presupposition that among these three doctrines the beginning is made with religion.
Insofar as no compendium is as yet available, the teacher must presumably be left the freedom to form the order and the connection here according to his own insight.

For my part, I know nothing other than to begin with right, the simplest and most abstract consequence of freedom, then to go on to morality and thence to religion as the highest stage. - But this circumstance concerns more closely the nature of the content to be treated, and a further exposition does not belong here.
zh: 要就此进入更细的说明：1. 就第一门教学科目而言，规章中用的是「宗教学说、法权学说与义务论」这一表述，其中预设了在这三门学说之中要以宗教作为开端。
既然目前还没有可用的汇编，那么大概就必须给教师留出这样的自由：由他按自己的洞见去安排这一部分的次序与关联。
就我而言，我所知道的不过是以「法」——自由最简单也最抽象的结论——为开端，然后进到道德，再由那里进到宗教这一最高阶段。——不过这一情况更切近于所要处理的内容的本性，进一步的阐述不属于此处。

en: If the question were raised whether this subject of instruction is suited to make the beginning of the introduction to philosophy, I can answer it in no other way than affirmatively.

The concepts of these doctrines are simple and at the same time have a determinacy which makes them entirely accessible to the age of this class; their content is supported by the natural feeling of the pupils, it has a reality within them, for it is the side of inner reality itself.

I therefore prefer this subject of instruction far to logic for this class, because logic has a more abstract, and above all a merely theoretical content remote from that immediate reality of the inner.
Freedom, right, property and so on are practical determinations with which we deal daily and which, apart from that immediate one, also have a sanctioned existence and real validity.

The logical determinations of the universal and the particular and so on are, for the spirit which is not yet at home in thinking, shadows against the reality to which it has recourse before it has learned to hold and to consider them independently of this.
The usual demand made on an introductory teaching of philosophy is indeed that one should begin with what exists and from there lead consciousness on to the higher, to thought.

But in the concepts of freedom the existing and immediate is itself present which is at the same time already a thought, without any preceding anatomy, analysis, abstraction and so on. - So in these doctrines one does in fact begin with what is demanded, with the true, the spiritual, the actual. - I have always found in this class a greater interest in these practical determinations than in the little theoretical material I had to send before it, and I have felt the difference of this interest still more since the first time, following the direction of the explanatory part of the regulations, I began with the fundamental concepts of logic; since then I have not repeated it.
zh: 如果提出这样一个问题：这门教学科目是否适合作为哲学入门的第一课，那么我只能作肯定的回答。
这些学说的概念是简单的，同时又带有一种规定性，使它们对于这个年级的年龄完全可及；它们的内容得到学生自然感觉的支撑，它们在学生内在具有一种现实性，因为它们正是内在现实性本身的那一面。
因此，就这个年级而言，我远远更偏爱这门教学科目而不是逻辑学，因为后者具有更抽象的、并且主要是远离内在那种直接现实性的、纯理论的内容。
自由、法、财产等等是我们每天与之打交道的实践规定，除了那种直接的规定之外，它们还具有一种得到认可的存在和实在的有效性。
关于普遍者与特殊者等等的逻辑规定，对于尚未安家于思维之中的精神来说，只是相对于它所倚靠的那个现实者的影子；只有在它学会不依赖后者而把握与考察这些规定之前，情况才是如此。
对哲学的入门教学通常的要求确实是：应当从现存者出发，并由此把意识引向更高处、引向思想。
但在自由的诸概念中，那现存者与直接者本身就已经在场，而它同时——无需事先的解剖、分析、抽象等等——已经是思想了。——因此，在这些学说中确实是依照所要求者、依照那真者、那精神者、那现实者开始的。——我在这个年级上一直对那些实践规定比对不得不先行讲授的那一点点理论材料有更大的兴趣；而自从我第一次依照规章说明部分的指示以逻辑学的基本概念开始之后，对这一差别的感受就更为强烈；从那以后我便没有再这样做。

en: The higher stage for the learner is the theoretically spiritual: the logical, the metaphysical, the psychological.

Comparing the logical and the psychological to begin with, the logical is on the whole to be reckoned the easier, because it has simpler, abstract determinations for its content, whereas the psychological is something concrete, and indeed the spirit itself.

But psychology is too easy if it is to be taken in so trivial a manner as that of purely empirical psychology, as for instance in Campe's Psychology for Children113). - What I know of [Carl Gustav] Carus's manner is so tedious, edifying, lifeless and spiritless that it is simply not to be endured.
zh: 对学习者来说，更高的阶段是理论上精神性的东西，即逻辑的、形而上学的、心理学的。
先把逻辑的与心理学的作一比较：总的来说，逻辑的应当算是较容易的，因为它的内容是更简单、更抽象的规定；而心理学的东西则是一个具体之物，甚至就是精神本身。
但如果心理学被当作纯粹经验心理学那样浅近——例如像坎普的《儿童心理学》113)那样——那就太容易了。——我关于[卡尔·古斯塔夫]·卡鲁斯那种写法所知道的，是如此乏味、如此说教、如此无生气、如此无精神，以致简直无法忍受。

en: I divide the delivery of psychology into two parts, a) of the appearing, b) of the spirit existing in and for itself; - in the former I treat consciousness according to my Phenomenology of Spirit, but only in the three first stages designated there, 1.
consciousness, 2.
self-consciousness, 3.
reason, in it the sequence of stages from feeling, intuition, representation, imagination and so on.

I distinguish the two parts in such a way that the spirit as consciousness is active upon the determinations as upon objects and its determining becomes for it a relation to an object, whereas as spirit it is active only upon its own determinations and the changes in it are determined as its activities and are so considered.
zh: 我把心理学的讲授分为两部分：a) 显现着的精神，b) 自在自为的精神；——在前一部分中，我按照我的《精神现象学》处理意识，但只限于那里所标明的前三个阶段，1.
意识，2.
自我意识，3.
理性，在其中从感觉、直观、表象、想象力等等开始的阶段序列。
我这样区分这两个部分：精神作为意识，是把诸规定当作对象而活动的，它的規定对精神自身就成为与对象的一种关系；而精神作为精神，则只对自己的诸规定而活动，其中的变化被规定为它的诸种行动，并且是这样被看待的。

en: Since logic is the other science of the middle class, metaphysics accordingly seems to come away empty-handed.
In any case this is a science with which nowadays one is wont to be embarrassed.
In the regulations the Kantian exposition of the antinomical cosmology and of the equally dialectical natural theology is given.
In fact what is prescribed thereby is not so much metaphysics itself as the dialectic of it, whereby this part returns again into logic, namely as dialectic.
zh: 既然逻辑学是中年级的另一门科学，形而上学似乎就要落空了。
无论如何，这是一门今天人们往往不知如何是好的学问。
规章中列明了康德对二律背反的宇宙论以及同样辩证的自然神学的表述。
实际上由此被规定的主要不是形而上学本身，而是它的辩证法，于是这一部分又回到了逻辑学，即作为辩证法而回到逻辑学。

en: According to my view of logic, the metaphysical anyhow falls entirely within it.
Here I can cite Kant as predecessor and authority.
His critique reduces the metaphysics hitherto existing to a consideration of understanding and reason.

Logic can therefore be taken in the Kantian sense in such a way that, besides the ordinary content of the so-called general logic, what he designates as transcendental logic is at the same time connected with it and prefixed to it - namely, as regards content, the doctrine of the categories, the notions of reflection and then the notions of reason. - Analytics and dialectic. - These objective forms of thought are an independent content, the part of the Aristotelian Organon de categoriis - or the former ontology.

Further they are independent of the metaphysical system; they occur in the transcendental idealism quite as much as in dogmatism; the latter calls them the determinations of the entium, the former those of the understanding. - My Objective Logic will, as I hope, serve to purify the science once more and to present it in its true dignity.
Until it becomes better known, those Kantian distinctions already contain the requisite or coarse version of it.
zh: 依我对逻辑学的看法，形而上学的部分本来就完全归在它之内。
这一点我可以引康德作为先驱与权威。
他的批判把迄今为止的形而上学归结为对知性与理性的考察。
因此，逻辑学可以按康德的意义来理解：除了所谓一般逻辑学的通常内容之外，他称之为先验逻辑学的那一部分也与之相联结并被置于其前——就内容而言，即关于范畴、反思概念以及随后关于理性概念的学说。——分析论与辩证法。——这些客观的思维形式本身就是一个独立的内容，即亚里士多德《范畴篇》（Organon de categoriis）的那一部分——或者说，从前的本体论。
此外，它们独立于形而上学体系；它们在先验观念论中与在独断论中同样出现：后者称之为存在者（entium）的规定，前者称之为知性的规定。——我的《客观逻辑学》将如我所愿，有助于重新净化这门学问，并把它按其真正的尊严呈现出来。
在它被更多地认识之前，康德那些区分已经包含了它的必要而粗略的形态。

en: With regard to the Kantian antinomies their dialectical aspect will be mentioned further on below.
As for their other content, it is partly the logical, partly the world in time and space, matter.

Insofar as in logic only their logical content - namely the antinomical categories which they contain - comes up, it falls away that they concern cosmology; but in truth that further content, namely the world, matter and the like, is also a useless ballast, a cloud-image of the representation, which has no value. - As for the Kantian critique of natural theology, it can, as I have done, be undertaken in the doctrine of religion, in which such material is particularly welcome for a three- or respectively four-year course.

It is of interest partly to give a knowledge of the so famous proofs of the existence of God, partly to make known the equally famous Kantian critique of them, partly to criticize this critique in turn.
zh: 至于康德的二律背反，其辩证的一面下文还会提到。
至于它们其余的内容，一部分是逻辑的，一部分是在时间与空间中的世界，即物质。
就逻辑学中只出现其逻辑内容——即它们所含的那些二律背反的范畴——而言，那么它们关乎宇宙论这一点就被略过了；但事实上，那更远的内容，即世界、物质之类，也同样是无用的压舱物，是表象的一团雾影，毫无价值。——至于康德对自然神学的批判，正如我所做的，可以在宗教学说中进行；对一个三年或四年的课程来说，这样的材料尤其受欢迎。
这件事有它的意义：一方面要让人获得关于那些著名的上帝存在证明的知识，另一方面要让人知道同样著名的康德对它们的批判，第三方面又要反过来批判这批判。

en: The encyclopedia, since it is to be philosophical, essentially excludes the literary encyclopedia, which is void of content in any case and not yet useful to the young people either.

It can contain nothing other than the general content of philosophy, namely the fundamental concepts and principles of its particular sciences, of which I count three main sciences: 1. logic, 2. the philosophy of nature, 3. the philosophy of spirit.

All other sciences which are regarded as non-philosophical do indeed fall into these according to their beginnings, and according to these beginnings alone they are to be considered in the encyclopedia, because it is philosophical. - As appropriate as it may be to give such an overview of the elements in the gymnasium, it may also on closer consideration be regarded as superfluous - because the sciences which in the encyclopedia are to be briefly considered have in fact already been in existence for the most part, more extensively than so.

Namely the first science of the encyclopedia, logic, of which I have already spoken above; the third science, the doctrine of spirit, 1. in psychology, 2. in the doctrine of right, of duty and of religion (psychology itself, as the science which splits into the two parts of theoretical and practical spirit or of intellect and will, can for the most part dispense with the exposition of its second part, because that part has already in its truth occurred as the doctrine of right, of duty and of religion).

For the merely psychological side of the latter, namely feelings, desires, drives, inclinations, is only something formal which, according to its true content - for example the drive to acquire or to know, the inclination of parents towards their children and so on - has already been treated in the doctrine of right or of duty as a necessary relation, as the duty of acquisition with the restriction of the principles of right, as the duty of forming oneself, as the duties of parents and children and so on.) - Since the doctrine of religion also belongs to the third science of the encyclopedia, a special instruction too is devoted to it.

To begin with, therefore, only the second science, the philosophy of nature, is left for the encyclopedia. - But 1. the observation of nature has as yet little charm for the young people; they feel the interest in nature more - and not without right - as a theoretical idleness by comparison with human and spiritual doing and shaping; 2. the observation of nature is the harder thing; for the spirit, in comprehending nature, has to transform the opposite of the concept into the concept - a power of which only the strengthened thinking is capable; 3. the philosophy of nature, as speculative physics, presupposes acquaintance with natural appearances - with empirical physics - an acquaintance which is not yet present here. - When in the fourth year of the existence of the gymnasium I received in the upper class such pupils as had run through the three courses of philosophy in the middle and lower classes, I had to make the observation that they were already acquainted with the greater part of the philosophical circle of science and that I could do without the greater part of the encyclopedia; I then held myself above all to the philosophy of nature. - On the other hand I felt it desirable that one side of the philosophy of spirit, namely the part of the beautiful, should be treated more fully.
Apart from the philosophy of nature, aesthetics is the particular science which is still lacking in the scientific cycle, and it seems to be very essentially capable of being a gymnasium science.
It could be assigned to the professor of classical literature in the upper class, who however already has enough to do with this literature and to whom it would be very harmful to take away hours.
But it would be most useful if the gymnasium pupils received, besides a greater grasp of metrics, more determinate concepts of the nature of epic, tragedy, comedy and the like.

Aesthetics could on the one hand give the newer and better views of the essence and the purpose of art, but on the other hand it must not remain a mere watery expanse of art, but must, as said, enter into the particular genres of poetry and the particular poetic manners of antiquity and of modern times, introduce an acquaintance with the leading poets of the different nations and ages, and support this acquaintance with examples. - This would indeed be a course as instructive as it is agreeable; it would contain nothing but such knowledge as is most fitting for gymnasium pupils, and it may be regarded as a real lack that this science forms no subject of instruction in a gymnasium. - The encyclopedia would in this way, as regards the matter, be present in the gymnasium with the exception of the philosophy of nature; there would only still be missing a philosophical view of history, which partly is still to be dispensed with, partly can also find its place elsewhere, for example in the philosophy of religion in the doctrine of providence.

The general division of the whole domain of philosophy, that there are three of them, pure thinking, nature and spirit, must in any case be mentioned often in the determination of the individual sciences.
zh: 百科全书既然应当是哲学的，就从根本上排除了那种本就没有内容、而且对青年尚无用处的文学式百科全书。
它所能包含的无非是哲学的一般内容，即其各门特殊科学的基本概念与原则；这些特殊科学我数出三门主要科学：1. 逻辑学，2. 自然哲学，3. 精神哲学。
所有被视为非哲学的其他学问，就其开端而言确实都归入这三门；而按这些开端，它们才应当被收进百科全书，因为它是哲学的。——在文科中学给出这样一份要素的概览固然切合实用，但在更仔细的考察之下，它也可以被认为是多余的——因为那些在百科全书中只需简要考察的学问，事实上大多早已在世，而且比这更详尽。
即：百科全书的第一门科学逻辑学，上文已经谈过；第三门科学即关于精神的学说，1. 在心理学中，2. 在法权、义务与宗教学说中（心理学本身作为一门分成理论精神与实践精神、或者说理智与意志两部分的学问，大体上可以免去对其第二部分的阐述，因为这一部分就其真理而言已经作为法权、义务与宗教学说出现过了）。
因为后者那纯粹心理的一面，即感觉、欲求、冲动、倾向，只不过是一种形式的东西；就其真实内容而言——例如获取的冲动与追求知识的冲动、父母对子女的偏爱等等——它在法权学说或义务论中已经作为必然的关系、作为受法权原则限制的获取义务、作为自我形成的义务、作为父母与子女的义务等等被处理过了。）——由于宗教学说也属于百科全书的第三门科学，因此也为它单设了一门课。

因此，起初只有第二门科学、即自然哲学还留在百科全书里。——然而，1. 对自然的观察对青年来说吸引力还不大；他们更多地——而且并非没有道理地——是在与人类和精神的作为与塑造相比较时，才感受到那对自然的兴趣不过是一种理论上的无所事事；2. 对自然的观察是较难的一桩；因为精神在理解自然时，必须把概念的反面转化为概念——这是一种只有得到加强的思维才能胜任的力量；3. 自然哲学作为思辨的物理学，以对自然现象——即以经验物理学——的熟悉为前提，而这种熟悉在这里还不存在。——当我在文科中学存在的第四年于高年级接到那些已在中年级与低年级修完三门哲学课程的学生时，我不得不作出这样的观察：他们已经熟悉了哲学科学范围中最大的一部分，而我可以不需要百科全书的绝大部分；于是我主要依循自然哲学。——另一方面，我觉得合乎期望的是，精神哲学的一个侧面，即关于美的这一部分，能得到更充分的阐述。
除自然哲学之外，美学是在科学循环中尚缺的唯一一门特殊学问，而它似乎极有可能是文科中学的一门学问。
它可以交由高年级的古典文学教授去教，但这位教授在这门文学上已经够忙了，夺走他的课时会对他大有损害。
不过，如果文科中学的学生除了对韵律学有更多的理解之外，还能获得关于史诗、悲剧、喜剧等等之性质的更为确定的概念，那将是最有益的。

美学一方面可以就艺术之本质与目的给出更新的、更好的见解，另一方面它也不该只是关于艺术的一片汪洋，而应当如所说，深入到各种特殊的诗体以及古代与现代各种特殊的诗歌方式之中，开启与不同时代、不同民族的最杰出诗人之间那种有特征的相识，并以例证支撑这种相识。——这样一来，这门课程确实既富于教益又令人愉快；它所包含的无非是那些对文科中学学生最为合适的知识，而这门学问在一所文科中学里不构成一门教学科目，可以算作一个实在的缺憾。——如此一来，就事情本身而言，百科全书在文科中学里除自然哲学之外都已具备；所缺的不过是关于历史的一种哲学观点而已，而这种观点一部分尚可省去，一部分也可以在别处——例如在宗教哲学关于护佑的学说中——找到它的位置。
哲学整个领域的一般划分——即它分为三者：纯粹思维、自然与精神——在确定各个具体学问时本来就要经常提到。

en: A. In general one distinguishes a philosophical system with its particular sciences and philosophizing itself.

According to the modern craving, especially of pedagogy, one is not so much to be instructed in the content of philosophy as to learn to philosophize without content; that is roughly: one is to travel and always travel without getting to know the cities, rivers, countries, people and so on.
zh: A. 一般说来，人们区分[一个]有各项特殊科学的哲学体系与哲学活动本身。
按照现代的癖好，尤其是教育学方面的癖好，人们要的不是受教于哲学的内容，而是学会无内容的哲学活动；这大致等于说：人们要去旅行，而且总是旅行，却不去认识城市、河流、国土、人等等。

en: For a start: when one gets to know a city and then comes to a river, to another city and so on, one anyhow learns to travel in the process, and one does not only learn it, but is already really travelling.
So, when one gets to know the content of philosophy, one does not only learn philosophizing, but is already really philosophizing.
The purpose of learning to travel would itself only be to get to know the content of those cities and so on.
zh: 首先，当人们认识一座城市，然后来到一条河、另一座城市等等时，人们在这种场合本来就顺便学会了旅行；而且人们不只是学会它，而是已经真正在旅行。
同样，当人们认识哲学的内容时，人们不只是学会哲学活动，而是已经真正在进行哲学活动。
而学习旅行这一目的本身，也不过是为了认识那些城市等等的内容。

en: Secondly, philosophy contains the highest rational thoughts about the essential objects, it contains the universal and the true of them; it is of great importance to become familiar with this content and to get these thoughts into the head.

The sad, merely formal behaviour, the perennial search and roaming without content, the unsystematic ratiocination or speculation has as its consequence the emptiness of content, the thoughtlessness of heads, so that they can do nothing.

The doctrine of right, morality, religion is a range of important content; likewise logic is a science full of content, the objective (Kant: transcendental) containing the fundamental thoughts of being, essence, force, substance, cause and so on, the other the concepts, judgments, syllogisms and so on, equally important fundamental determinations, - psychology feeling, intuition and so on; - the philosophical encyclopedia finally the whole range.

The Wolffian sciences, logic, ontology, cosmology and so on, natural law, morality and so on, have more or less disappeared; but it is not thereby any the less a systematic complex of sciences full of content. - Further, however, the cognition of the absolutely absolute (for those sciences are to learn their particular content also in its truth, that is, in its absoluteness) is possible only through the cognition of the totality in its stages of a system; and those sciences are its stages.
The fear of a system demands a pillar of God which is to have no form.
Unsystematic philosophizing is a haphazard, fragmentary thinking, and precisely the consequence of it is the formal soul in place of the true content.
zh: 其次，哲学包含着关于本质性对象的最卓越的理性思想，包含着它们的普遍者与真者；熟悉这一内容并把这些思想装进头脑，是极为重要的。
那种可悲的纯粹形式上的行为，那种年复一年的无内容的寻觅与游荡，那种没有系统的推论或思辨，其后果就是内容的空洞与头脑的思想贫乏，以致它们什么也做不成。
法权学说、道德学说、宗教构成一片重要内容的范围；同样，逻辑学是一门内容充实的学问：客观逻辑学（康德称之为先验逻辑学）包含关于存在、本质、力、实体、原因等等的基本思想，另一门则包含概念、判断、推论等等同样重要的基本规定——心理学则包含感觉、直观等等——哲学百科全书最终包含整个范围。
沃尔夫的诸门学问——逻辑学、本体论、宇宙论等等，自然法、道德学说等等——或多或少地消失了；但哲学并不因此少一分是一个内容充实的诸学问的系统复合体。——而且，对绝对绝对者的认识（因为那些学问也应当在它们的真理中，即在它们的绝对性中认识自己的特殊内容），只有通过在某个系统的诸阶段中认识总体性才成为可能；而那些学问正是它的诸阶段。
对体系的畏惧要求的是一尊不该有形体的上帝雕像。
没有体系的哲学活动是一种偶然的、片段式的思考；而这恰恰导致以形式的灵魂取代真实的内容。

en: Thirdly.
The procedure in becoming familiar with a philosophy full of content is then no other than learning.
Philosophy must be taught and learned, as well as every other science.

The unfortunate itching to educate to self-thinking and to one's own producing has put this truth in the shade - as if, when I learn what substance, cause or whatever it may be, I did not myself think; as if I did not myself produce these determinations in my thinking but rather threw them into it like stones; - as if further, when I see their truth, the proofs of their synthetic relations, or their dialectical passage, I did not myself gain this insight and did not myself persuade myself of these truths; - as if, when I have become familiar with the Pythagorean theorem and its proof, I did not myself know this proposition and prove its truth.
As much as the philosophical study is in itself a doing for oneself, just as much is it a learning - the learning of an already existing, developed science.
This is a treasure of acquired, worked out, formed content; this existing inheritance is to be acquired by the individual, that is, learned.
The teacher possesses it; he thinks it in advance, the pupils think it after.

The philosophical sciences contain the universal true thoughts about their objects; they are the resultant product of the labour of the thinking geniuses of all ages; these true thoughts surpass what an uneducated young man brings out with his thinking by as much as that mass of genial labour surpasses the effort of such a young man.

The original, proper representing of the young people about the essential objects is partly still quite scanty and empty, but partly, in its infinitely greater part, opinion, delusion, halfunderstanding, crookedness, indeterminacy.
Through learning the truth takes the place of this imagining.

Only when the head is full of thoughts does it first have the possibility to carry the science further itself and to win a true individuality in it; hence in public institutions of instruction, and in gymnasia quite especially, it is not the thing to do, but the philosophical study is essentially to be directed to this point of view: that through it something is learned, ignorance is expelled, the empty head is filled with thoughts and content, and that natural individuality of thinking, that is, the contingency, arbitrariness, particularity of opinion, is driven out.
zh: 第三，
那么，与一门内容充实的哲学相熟悉的过程，无非就是学习。
哲学必须被教与被学，如同每一门其他学问一样。

那种不幸的、想要培养人自行思考与自行生产的冲动，把这一真理掩盖起来了——好像当我学会实体、原因或任何别的东西时，我不是自己思考似的；好像我不是在自己的思考中亲自生产出这些规定，而是把它们当作石子投进思考里似的；——又好像当我看清它们的真理、它们之综合关系的证明或它们的辩证过渡时，我不是自己获得了这一洞见、不是自己被这些真理说服了似的；——又好像当我熟悉了毕达哥拉斯定理及其证明时，我不是自己知道这个命题、自己证明其真理似的。
哲学研究就其自身而言固然是自作自为之事，但它同样是一种学习——学习一门已经存在、已经成形了的学问。
这门学问是一份由获取、提炼与涵养而成的宝藏；这份既有的遗产应当由个人获取，也就是说，应当被学习。
教师拥有它；他把它预先思考出来，学生们则随后把它思考出来。
哲学的诸门学问包含着关于其对象的那些普遍而真的思想；它们是历代思考着的天才们劳动的最终产物；这些真的思想超越一个未受教化的年轻人凭自己的思考所能产出的东西，其程度正如那堆积的天才劳动超越这样一个年轻人的努力。
青年对本质性对象的原创的、固有的表象，一部分仍然十分贫乏而空洞，但在其大得无限的部分中，则是意见、幻觉、一知半解、歪曲与不定性。
通过学习，真理取代了这种胡思乱想。
只有当头脑装满了思想，它才第一次具有继续推进这门学问、并在其中赢得一种真实独创性的可能；因此在公立教学机构里、在文科中学里尤其如此，那就更不该去做那另一件事，而哲学研究本质上必须对准这一着眼点：借此学到东西，驱走无知，让空虚的头脑被思想与内容填满，并把思维的那种自然独创性——即意见的偶然性、任意性与特殊性——驱散出去。

en: B. The philosophical content has in its method and soul three forms; 1. it is abstract, 2. dialectical, 3. speculative.

Abstract, insofar as it is in the element of thinking as such; but merely abstract as opposed to the dialectical and the speculative, it is the so-called understanding which holds fast the determinations in their fixed differences and gets to know them.
The dialectical is the movement and confusion of those fixed determinacies - the negative reason.
The speculative is the positively rational, the spiritual, only then properly the philosophical.
zh: B. 哲学内容在其方法与灵魂上有三种形式；1. 它是抽象的，2. 辩证的，3. 思辨的。
抽象的，就它处于思维这一要素之中而言；但只是相对于辩证的与思辨的而言才是抽象的，它就是所谓的知性，它把诸规定固定在它们稳固的差别之中并加以认识。
辩证的乃是那些固定规定性的运动与扰乱——即否定性的理性。
思辨的乃是正面的理性、精神性的东西，才是真正哲学性的东西。

en: As regards the delivery of philosophy in gymnasia, in the first place the abstract form is at first the main thing.

To the young people the seeing and hearing must first pass away; they must be withdrawn from the concrete representing, drawn back into the inner night of the soul, and learn on this ground to see, to hold fast and to distinguish determinations.
zh: 就文科中学中哲学的讲授而言，首先，抽象的形式一开始就是主要之点。
对青年来说，首先必须让看与听过去；他们必须从具体的表象中被拉出来，被拉回灵魂的内在黑夜之中，并在这块地基上学会看，学会固定并区分各种规定。

en: Further, one learns to think abstractly by thinking abstractly.

For one can either want to begin from the sensible, the concrete, and to prepare it up into the abstract by analysis, taking - as it seems - the natural course, ascending too from the easier to the harder.
Or else one can begin straight away with the abstract itself and take, teach and make intelligible the same in and for itself.
First, as regards the comparison of the two ways, the first is indeed more natural, but for that very reason it is the unscientific way.

Although it is more natural that a disk containing the round approximately should have been rounded off gradually from a tree-trunk by planing away the unequal, projecting little pieces, the geometer nevertheless does not proceed in this way, but with the compasses or freehand he makes at once an exact abstract circle.

It is appropriate to the matter, because the pure, the higher, the true is natura prius, and one must also begin with it in science; for science is the perversion of merely natural, that is, unspiritual representing; truly that is the first, and science is to do as it truly is. - Secondly it is a complete error to hold that natural way, which begins with the concrete sensible and proceeds to thought, to be the easier one.

It is on the contrary the harder one - as it is easier to pronounce and to read the elements of speech, the single letters, than whole words. - Because the abstract is the simpler, it is easier to comprehend.
The concrete sensible accompaniment is anyhow to be struck out; it is therefore superfluous to take it along beforehand, since it has to be removed again, and it only causes distraction.
The abstract is intelligible enough as such, as much as is needed; the right understanding is in any case only to come into it through philosophy.
It is therefore a matter of getting the thoughts of the universe into the head; but thoughts are in general the abstract.
Formal, contentless ratiocination is indeed abstract enough as well.

But it is presupposed that one has content and the right content; the empty formalism, the contentless abstraction, even if it be about the absolute, is best driven out precisely by what has been said above, namely by the delivery of a determinate content.
zh: 此外，人是通过抽象的思维而学会抽象地思考的。
因为人们要么想从感性的、具体的东西出发，通过分析把它提炼并上升为抽象者——这样看来是采取自然的进程——也就是从较容易者上升到较困难者；
要么人们干脆直接从抽象者本身开始，就其自在自为的样子去把握它、教授它并使之明白易懂。
首先，就两条道路的比较而言，第一条固然更合乎自然，但正因如此它才是不科学的道路。
虽然更合乎自然的做法是：从一段树干上削去那些不平等而凸出的碎块，逐渐把一块大致含圆的圆盘修圆；但几何学家并不这样做法，他用圆规或徒手径直作出一个精确的抽象圆。
这是合乎事情本身的，因为那纯粹的、那更高的、那真的乃是有先于自然的（natura prius），在科学中也应当由它开始；因为科学正是那种纯粹合乎自然的、也就是无精神的表象之颠倒；真正说来，那前者才是第一的，而科学应当照真实的样子去做。——其次，把那条合乎自然的、从具体感性出发进而走向思想的道路当作较容易的道路，是全然的谬误。
它毋宁说是较难的那一条——正如读出并读懂语音的要素、一个个字母，比读整词更容易一样。——因为抽象者是较为简单者，所以它更容易把握。
具体的感性附加物本来就要划去；因此预先把它带进来是多余的，因为它随后还得被除掉，而它只会使人分心。
抽象者本身已经足够明白易懂，就其必要而言；真正的知性本来也就要通过哲学才进入其中。
因此要紧的是把关于宇宙的思想装进头脑；而思想一般说来就是那抽象者。
形式的、没有内容的推论固然也够抽象的。
但这里预设着人们有内容、有真正的内容；空洞的形式主义、没有内容的抽象，即使它以上帝为对象，也恰恰要靠上面所说的东西来驱散，那就是靠讲授课确定的内容。

en: If one holds fast merely to the abstract form of the philosophical content, one has a (so-called) understanding philosophy; and since in the gymnasium it is a matter of introduction and subject-matter, that understanding content, that systematic mass of abstract concepts full of content, is immediately the philosophical as subject-matter and is the introduction, because the subject-matter is in general the first thing for a real, appearing thinking.
This first stage therefore seems to have to be the prevailing one in the gymnasium sphere.
zh: 如果人们单单抓住哲学内容的抽象形式，那就得到一种（所谓的）知性的哲学；而且既然在文科中学里所关的是入门与材料，那么那种知性的内容、那种由抽象而有内容的概念所构成的系统性堆积，便直接就是作为材料而言的哲学，并且就是入门，因为材料一般说来对于一种现实的、显现出来的思维来说是第一的。
因此这第一个阶段看来必定是文科中学范围里占主导地位的。

en: The second stage of the form is the dialectical.
This is partly harder than the abstract, partly the least interesting for the young people who are greedy for subject-matter and for fulfilment.

The Kantian antinomies are given in the regulations with a view to cosmology; they contain a deep foundation concerning the antinomical of reason, but this foundation lies in them too hidden and, so to speak, thoughtless and too little recognized in its truth; on the other hand they are really too poor a dialectic - nothing more than scribbled antitheses: in my logic I have, as I believe, thrown light on them as they deserve.

Infinitely better is the dialectic of the old Eleatics and the examples which are preserved for us of it. - Since in a systematic whole every new concept really arises through the dialectic of the preceding one, the teacher, who knows this nature of the philosophical, has the freedom to make the attempt with dialectic everywhere as often as he likes and, where it finds no entrance, to pass on to the next concept without it.
zh: 形式的第二个阶段是辩证的。
它一方面比抽象者更难，另一方面对那些渴求材料与充实感的青年来说又最无趣味。
康德的二律背反在规章中是着眼于宇宙论而列出的；它们包含着关于理性之二律背反的一项深刻基础，但这基础在它们里面隐藏得太深，可以说未经思想、也太少在其真理中被认识；另一方面，它们确实是一个太糟糕的辩证法——无非是涂写出来的对立命题：我在我的逻辑学中依我之见按其应得之分给它们作了阐明。
古代埃利亚派人的辩证法以及为我们保存下来的那些范例，则要好得无限。——既然在一个系统的整体中，每一个新概念其实都是通过前一个概念的辩证法而产生的，那么懂得这种哲学本性的教师就有自由随处尝试辩证法，随他愿意试多少次都行；而在它找不到入口的地方，则可以撇开它而转入下一个概念。

en: The third is the properly speculative, that is, the cognition of the opposite in its unity, - or more precisely, that the opposites are one in their truth.
This speculative is only then the properly philosophical.

It is naturally the hardest; it is the truth, it itself is present in a double form: 1. in the common form, brought nearer to the representing, to the imagination, and also to the heart, e.g. when one speaks of the general life of nature which moves itself and shapes itself in infinite form - pantheism and the like -, when one speaks of the eternal love of God, who is therefore creator in order to love, in order to behold himself in his eternal Son and then in a Son given over to temporality, the world, and so on.

Right, self-consciousness, the practical in general already contain in and for themselves the principles or beginnings of it, and of the spirit and of the spiritual there is properly not a word to be said except a speculative one, for it is the unity in other-being with itself; otherwise one speaks, even if one needs the words soul, spirit, God, yet only of stones and coals. - Now if one speaks of the spiritual merely abstractly or in an understanding way, the content can nevertheless be speculative - just as the content of the complete religion is highly speculative.
But then the delivery, whether it be enthusiastic or, if it is not, as it were narrative, brings the object only before the representation, not into the concept.
zh: 第三是真正思辨的东西，即对立者在其统一中的认识——或者更确切地说，对立者在其真理中是一体的。
这种思辨的东西才是真正哲学性的东西。
它自然是那最难的；它就是真理，它本身以双重形式存在：1. 以那种更贴近表象、贴近想象力、也贴近心灵的一般形式，例如人们谈论自然那普遍的、自我运动并以无限方式塑造自身的生命时——泛神论之类——又如人们谈论上帝那永恒的爱时，上帝之所以是创造者，正是为了爱，为了在他永恒的儿子中、继而在一个献给时间性的儿子中观照自己并观照世界等等。
法、自我意识以及实践这一总体，就其自在自为而言已经包含了它的原则或开端；而对于精神与精神性的东西，严格说来，除了用思辨的方式之外不能说出任何一个字来，因为它正是在他在之中与自身相统一的统一；否则，即便人们需要灵魂、精神、上帝这些词，所说的也不过是石头与煤。——如今人们若只是抽象地或以知性的方式谈论精神性的东西，其内容仍然可以是思辨的——正如完全宗教的内容是高度思辨的一样。
但这样一来，讲授无论是出于热忱还是——若非如此——近乎叙事，带来的都只是把对象摆到表象之前，而不是带入概念之中。

en: What is comprehended - and this means the speculative which emerges from the dialectic - alone is the philosophical in the form of the concept.

This can occur only sparingly in gymnasium teaching; it is grasped by few people altogether, and in part one cannot even properly know whether it is grasped by them. - Learning to think speculatively, which is given in the regulations as the main determination of the preparatory philosophical instruction, is therefore indeed to be regarded as the necessary goal; the preparation for it is the abstract and then the dialectical thinking, further the acquisition of representations of speculative content.
Since gymnasium instruction is essentially preparatory, it will consist above all in working towards these sides of philosophizing.
zh: 被把握住的东西——也就是从辩证法中产生出来的那个思辨者——唯有它是概念形式下的哲学。
这在文科中学的授课中只能偶尔出现；总的说来，能把握它的人很少，而且部分情况下甚至说不准他们是否把握了它。——学会思辨地思考——规章把它列为预备性哲学教学的主要规定——因此确实应当被视为必要的目的；为此的准备是抽象的、然后是辩证的思考，此外还有获得具有思辨内容的表象。
既然文科中学的教学本质上是预备性的，它就主要在于朝这些哲学活动的侧面努力。

39.zh: 黑格尔致尼特哈默的信114)

en: Nuremberg, 23.
October
zh: 纽伦堡，23. 日

en: You had commissioned me to put my thoughts on the delivery of philosophy in gymnasia on paper and to submit them to you.
I brought the first draft to paper some time ago already, but could not win any regular time any longer to work it out properly.

So as not to let it lie too long before sending you something about it in accordance with your request, I have it copied out for you in the shape it has reached after some further revision and now send it to you.
Since the essay has no other aim than a private one, it will be able to serve it just as it is.

The abruptness of the thoughts, and still more the polemical here and there, you will kindly ascribe to the imperfect form, which for any other purpose than that of expounding my opinion to you would indeed have required more smoothing.
The polemical may often be inconvenient, in so far as the essay is directed to you and accordingly there would otherwise be no one but you against whom the polemic could be made.
But you will of your own accord view the same quite simply as an occasional enthusiasm which overtook me when I mentioned this or that manner or view.
zh: 您曾委托我把关于在文科中学讲授哲学的想法写到纸上，呈交给您。
我早在前不久已经把第一份草稿写成了文字，却再也腾不出正当的时间来把它好好加工。
为了不让它再拖下去，按照您的要求把关于此事的文字寄给您好，我让人按它再经一番加工后的样子为您誊写一份，现在寄给您。
由于这篇文章没有别的、只是私人的目的，它就以现有的样子也能够达成这个目的。
思想的突兀，尤其是这里那里带着的论战色彩，请您姑且归因于形式的不完善——若不是为了向您陈述我的意见，而是为了别的目的，这种形式本来确实还需要更多的打磨。
这些论战色彩常常令人不适，因为这篇文章是呈给您的——否则除了您之外就没有可供论战的对象了。
不过您自会把这统统看作一时的高昂——当我说到这样或那样的做法与见解时，它突然就袭上我心头。

en: A concluding remark is still lacking, which I have not added, however, because I am not yet agreed with myself about it - namely that perhaps all philosophical instruction in gymnasia could seem superfluous, that the study of the ancients is what is most appropriate to the gymnasium youth and, as regards its substance, the true introduction into philosophy. - But how should I, the professor of the philosophical preparatory sciences, fight against my subject and my post and take the bread and water from my own mouth?

On the other hand, however, I - who ought also to be a philosophical pedagogue, and as rector even have an official duty in this respect - have finally also the nearer interest that the professors of the philosophical sciences in gymnasia be declared superfluous and be given either a different set of teaching hours or be moved elsewhere.
One thing however draws me back to the first page, namely the philology which is wholly taught and tends towards word-wisdom.

The Church Fathers, Luther and the old preachers quoted, expounded and handled the biblical texts in a free manner, in which, with regard to the historically learned, it did not matter to be in a peasant's shoe, if they could put the more doctrine and edification into it.
In place of the aesthetic concoction of pulcre, quam venuste, of which we still hear considerable echoes, word-critical and metrical scholarship is now the order of the day.
I do not know whether much of it has already broken out in the subordinate personnel under you.
But it too is impending, and in one case and another philosophy will come away rather empty.
zh: 还缺一个结尾的附注，我却没有补上，因为我在这一点上与自己还没有取得一致——即：也许文科中学里一切哲学教学都显得多余，古人的研究才是文科中学青年最相宜的，并且就其实体而言是真正的哲学入门。——可是我，作为哲学预备学科的教授，又怎能反对自己的专业与自己的职位，砸掉自己吃饭的饭碗呢？
不过另一方面，我——我本来就应当是一位哲学的教育家，而且作为校长在这一点上还有职务上的责任——最终也有一份切近的利害：人们把文科中学里哲学科学的教授宣布为多余，或者给他们换一份别的授课任务，或者把他们调往别处。
不过有一点又把我拉回第一页上，即那完全被当作学问来教、并且趋向于咬文嚼字的语文学。
教父们、路德与那些老布道家引用、注释并运用圣经经文时都带着一种自由的方式；就历史博学的人来说，穿着农民的鞋也无妨，只要他们能在其中塞进更多的教义与感化。
如今在位的，是以逐字考订与韵律考究为务的学问，用来取代对「pulcre, quam venuste」（多么优美，多么雅致）那种审美上的卖弄——我们还听得见它相当大的余响。
我不知道这一点是否已经在您属下的人员中蔓延开来。
不过这也摆在他们面前，而且在这一个那一个场合里，哲学都将相当落空。

43.en: 4. On the Delivery of Philosophy in Universities

en: Letter to the Royal Prussian government councillor and professor Friedrich v. Raumer116) (1816)
zh: 致普鲁士王国政府参议兼教授弗里德里希·冯·劳默阁下的信116)（1816）

en: To Your Excellency I take the liberty to submit, on the occasion of our oral conversation, my thoughts on the delivery of philosophy in universities in writing after the event.

I must request very earnestly that you will graciously take the form as it is and not demand more exposition and connection than can be given in a hurried letter which is still to catch you up in our vicinity.
zh: 谨向阁下呈上：应我们口头谈话之请，我把我关于在大学讲授哲学的想法事后写成文字奉上。
我必须恳请您在形式上也多多包涵，不要要求比一封匆忙写成、还来得及在您身边附近追上您的信中所能给出的更多的阐述与关联。

en: I begin at once with the observation of how this subject can in general come up for discussion, since otherwise it can seem a quite simple matter that only the same should hold of the delivery of philosophy as of that of the other sciences; in this respect I will not dwell on the fact that of the latter too it must be demanded that it combine clarity with thoroughness and appropriate fullness, that it also shares this fate with the delivery of the other sciences in a university, in that it has to be arranged for the sake of the appointed time - as a rule half a year - and that accordingly the science has to be stretched or compressed and so on.

The particular kind of embarrassment which can presently be observed with regard to the delivery of philosophy is probably to be sought in the turn which this science has taken and out of which the present relation has arisen: that the former scientific training of it and the particular sciences into which the philosophical material was distributed have become more or less antiquated in form and content, - but that on the other hand the idea of philosophy which has taken their place still stands without scientific training and the material of the particular sciences has not yet, or only incompletely, achieved its recasting and its reception into the new idea. - We therefore see on the one hand scientificity and sciences without interest, on the other hand interest without scientificity.
zh: 我先就说明：这一题目总的说来可以怎样提出来；否则事情看上去会很简单，仿佛关于哲学的讲授只需适用与别的学问的讲授相同的话即可。在这一点上我不想停留于这样一项事实：别的学问也同样必须被要求把明晰性同扎实性以及合乎分寸的详尽结合起来；也必须同样在大学中分享那种为着规定的时段——通常是一学期——而必须加以安排的命运，因而这门学问必须随之被拉长或压缩等等。

目前就哲学的讲授而言可以察觉到的那种特别的难堪，大概应当在这门学问所转过的那个弯子里去寻找，今天的关系正是从那里产生的：它以往的科学训练，以及哲学材料原先分散其中的那些特殊学问，在形式与内容上或多或少都已经陈旧过时；——但另一方面，顶替它们而起的哲学观念仍然没有科学上的训练，而那些特殊学问的材料尚未、或只是不完整地完成了自身的改造并被接纳进新的观念。——因此我们看到一方面是有科学性而无兴趣的学问，另一方面是有兴趣而无科学性。

en: What we therefore still see delivered on average in universities and in writings are some of the old sciences, logic, empirical psychology, natural law, perhaps also morality; for even to those who otherwise still hold to the older things metaphysics has gone to ruin, as to the faculty of law the German state law; if the remaining sciences which used to constitute metaphysics are not so greatly missed in this, then at least this must hold with regard to natural theology, whose object was the rational cognition of God.

Of those sciences which are still retained, particularly logic, it almost seems that it is mostly tradition and regard for the formal utility of the training of understanding which still preserves them; for their content, as well as their form and that of the rest, stands in too great a contrast with the idea of philosophy, upon which the interest has passed, and with the manner of philosophizing adopted by it, for them still to be able to afford a satisfying satisfaction.

If the young people only begin the study of the sciences now, they have nevertheless already been touched, be it only by an indefinite rumour of other ideas and fare, so that they approach the study of them without the required prejudice of authority and importance and easily fail to find that something of which they have already been given an expectation; I would say that the teaching of such sciences too, because of the once impressive contrast, no longer goes on with the unconcern and full confidence as formerly; an uncertainty or sensitiveness arising from this then does not contribute to gaining access and credit.
zh: 因此我们在大学里与在著作中平均所见、所讲的，依然是那些旧学问中的几门：逻辑学、经验心理学、自然法，或许还有道德学说；因为即便对那些仍旧执着于旧物的人，形而上学也已经像法学院失去德国国家法那样垮台了；如果说那些原本构成形而上学、其余的学问并没有被那么强烈地怀念，那么至少在自然神学方面情形如此，因为自然神学的对象乃是对上帝的理性认识。
在那些仍被保留的学问、尤其是逻辑学身上，几乎可以说使它们留存下来的主要是传统以及对训练知性的形式上的功利之考虑；因为它们的内容，以及它们和其余各门学问的形式，同那承接了兴趣的哲学观念、同那由这一观念所采纳的哲学活动方式，相抵触得如此厉害，以至于它们再也无法提供令人满意的满足。
即便青年现在才开始研究这些学问，他们毕竟也已经——哪怕只是被关于别的观念与食粮的模糊传闻所触动——以致他们在着手研究时并没有关于其权威与重要性的那种必要的先入之见，于是很容易找不到某物，即他们已经被激发出期待的那个东西；我想说，正因为那一次令人印象深刻的反差，对这类学问的教学也不再像从前那样带着不勉强的态度与充分的信任进行；由此产生的犹豫或敏感便无助于赢得接纳与信用。

en: On the other hand, the new idea has not yet fulfilled the demand to shape the wide field of objects which belong into philosophy into an ordered whole formed through its parts.

The demand of determinate cognitions and the otherwise acknowledged truth that the whole is comprehended truly only by working through the parts have not merely been evaded, but have been rejected with the assertion that the determinacy and manifoldness of knowledge is superfluous for the idea, nay contrary to it and beneath it.
According to such a view philosophy is as compendious as medicine, or at least the therapy, was in the days of Brown's117) system, according to which it could be completed in half an hour.

A philosopher who belongs to this intensive manner you have perhaps nevertheless met personally in Munich; Franz Baader now and then has one or two sheets printed which are to contain the whole essence of the whole of philosophy or of a particular science of it.
Whoever has only prints made in this manner still has the advantage of the public's belief that he is also a master in the execution of such general thoughts.

But I still experienced Friedrich Schlegel's appearance with lectures on transcendental philosophy in Jena; in six weeks he was finished with his course of lectures, not exactly to the satisfaction of his hearers, who had expected and paid for half a year. - We saw the general ideas given a greater breadth through the help of the imagination, which often, and just as often quite superficially, blended the high and the low, the near and the far, brilliantly and darkly with a deeper sense, and for that purpose used in particular those regions of nature and of spirit which are in themselves dark and arbitrary.

An opposite road to a greater extension is the critical and sceptical one, which has a subject-matter in the existing material on which it goes on, but in the end brings it to nothing more than the unsatisfying and wearisome results of negative mediations.

Even if this road perhaps serves to exercise acuteness, and the means of imagination may have had the effect of producing a temporary fermenting of the spirit, and perhaps of awakening what is called edification and of kindling the general idea itself in a few, yet none of these ways achieves what is to be achieved and what the study of science is.
zh: 另一方面，新的观念尚未兑现这样的要求：把那些应当进入哲学的广阔对象领域塑造成一个有序的、经过其各部分而形成的整体。
对于特定认识的要求，以及那条通常得到承认的真理——只有把各部分通习一遍，整体才被真正把握——不仅被回避了，而且被以这样的断言驳回：说知识的规定性与多发性对于观念是多余的，甚至与观念相违、居于观念之下。
依这样的看法，哲学就如同医学、或者至少如同布朗体系117)时代的治疗学那样简明扼要——按那个体系，它在半个钟头里就可以完成。
属于这种强烈做法的哲学家，您也许在慕尼黑还亲自见过他；弗朗茨·巴德尔时不时印上一两个印张，声称其中包含着整个哲学或其中某一门特殊学问的全部本质。
凡是以这种方式只管付印的人，还占着一个便宜：公众相信他在铺陈这类一般思想方面也是大师。

不过弗里德里希·施莱格尔以关于先验哲学的讲演在耶拿登场的那一幕，我还亲历过；他在六个星期里就把自己的讲课讲完了，而这些听众所期待并付费的是半年的课——这当然不能让他们满意。——我们看到，一般的观念借助想象力的帮助而获得更大的宽度：想象力常常——也同样常常只是十分表面地——把崇高与卑微、临近与遥远，以光辉与晦暗的方式，带着更深的意思掺和在一起，并且为此特别地动用了自然与精神中那些本身晦暗而任意的领域。
通向更大扩展的另一条相反的道路是批判的与怀疑论的道路；它在现有的材料上有一个可供继续加工的对象材料，但归根结底它所带来的无非是那些令人不快且令人厌倦的否定性结果。
即使这条道路或许可以训练敏锐的头脑，而想象力的这一手段也许能产生精神一时沸腾的效果，甚至能唤起人们所谓的感化、在少数人心中点燃那一般观念本身，然而这些做法没有一种能成就应当成就的东西，也不能成就学问之研究。

en: To the young people, at the beginning of the new philosophy, it was at first welcome to be able to dispense with the study of philosophy, yes of the sciences altogether, with a few general formulas which are to contain everything.

The consequences that follow closely from this opinion, a lack of knowledge, ignorance both in philosophical concepts and in the specific professional sciences, did however meet with too serious a contradiction and practical repudiation in the demands of the state as well as in the other scientific training, for that arrogance not to have lost its credit.

Just as the inner necessity of philosophy brings it about that it is to be developed scientifically and in its parts, so this also seems to me to be the appropriate standpoint; one cannot return to its former sciences, but the mass of concepts and content which they contained cannot merely be ignored either; the new form of the idea demands its right, and the old material therefore requires a recasting which is appropriate to the present standpoint of philosophy. - This view of what is appropriate, of course, I can only give as a subjective judgment, just as I too have to take at first the direction which I have taken in my treatment of philosophy to be a subjective one, in that I early set myself that goal; I have just now finished the publication of my works on logic and must now expect from the public how it takes up this manner.
zh: 在新的哲学开端之际，青年们先是乐于能够用几个据说包罗一切的一般公式，把哲学——乃至学问本身——的研究打发掉。
从这种意见中随即而来的后果——知识的缺乏、在哲学概念以及各门本行学问上的无知——却在国家的要求以及在别的科学教养那里遭遇了过于认真的矛盾与实践上的驳斥，以致那种自负并没有失掉它的信誉。

正如哲学的内在必然性要求它得到科学的、在其各部分上得到发展的那样，在我看来这也正是合乎时势的立场；不能回到它从前的诸门学问，但它们所包含的概念与内容的那一大堆也不能仅仅被无视；观念的新形式要求着自己的权利，因此旧材料需要一番改造，以合乎哲学当前的这个立场。——当然，关于何为合乎时势的这一看法，我只能把它当作一种主观的判断提出；同样，我也必须首先把我在哲学著述中所采取的那个方向看作主观的方向，因为我早就给自己定下了那个目的；我刚刚结束了我那些逻辑学著作的出版，如今必须期待公众如何接受这种方式。

en: So much, however, I believe, may rightly be assumed: that the delivery of philosophy in universities can achieve what it is to achieve - the acquisition of determinate knowledge - only if it takes a determinate, methodical course which comprehends and orders the detail.
In this form this science, like every other, is alone capable of being learned.
Even if the teacher may avoid this word, he must be aware that it is above all and essentially a matter of this.

It has become a prejudice not only of the philosophical study but also of pedagogy - and here even more widely so - that self-thinking is to be developed and exercised in the sense that in the first place it makes no difference what the material is, and in the second place as if learning were opposed to self-thinking, whereas in truth thinking can exercise itself only on a material which is no birth and composition of the imagination or no - be it sensible or intellectual intuition - but a thought, and further a thought cannot be learned otherwise than by being thought itself.

According to a common error, a thought seems to be stamped as self-thought only when it differs from the thoughts of other people, where then the saying applies that the new is not true and the true is not new; - otherwise from this there has arisen the craving that everyone wants to have his own system, and that an idea is held to be all the more original and excellent the more tasteless and crazy it is, because it thereby most proves the peculiarity and difference from the thought of others.
zh: 不过有几点我自以为可以正当地假定：大学中的哲学讲授，只有在它采取一种确定的、方法性的、涵盖并整理细节的进程时，才能成就它应当成就的东西——即对特定知识的获得。
以这种形式，这门学问像每一门其他学问一样，才具备被学习的可能。
即使教师愿意避开这个词，他也必须意识到：首要而且本质上正要处理的就是这件事。
不仅哲学研究、而且教育学——在这里还更为普遍地——形成了一个成见：认为自行思考应当在这个意义上来培养与操练，即首先它与材料是什么无关，其次仿佛学习与自行思考相对立似的；其实，思维只有在这样的材料上才能得到操练：这种材料不是想象的产物与拼凑，不是感性的或智性的直观，而是一个思想；并且，一个思想也只能通过被亲自思考出来而学到。
按照一种常见的谬误，一个思想似乎只有在不同于他人的思想时，才被打上「自思」的印记；这时那句老话就该适用了：新的不是真的，真的不是新的；——否则，从这里就生出了那种人人要有自己的体系的欲望，也生出了这样一种想法：一个念头越是乏味越是疯狂，就越被认为越是独创、越是卓越，因为它正是这样最能证明自己与他人思想的独特与相异。

en: The capacity of being learned philosophy attains more closely through its determinacy, in so far as thereby alone it becomes clear, communicable and capable of becoming a common possession.

Just as it on the one hand wants to be studied in particular and is not from the outset a common possession on that account, since every human being has reason as such, so on the other hand its general communicability takes from it the appearance which it also received among others in more recent times, that of being an idiosyncrasy of a few transcendental heads, and becomes appropriate to its true position, to be the second after philology as the first propaedeutic science for a profession.

It always remains open that some will get stuck at this second stage, but at least not for the reason which some of them had, who, because they had otherwise learned nothing right, became philosophers.
In any case that danger does not seem to be so great any more as I mentioned before, and in any case it is smaller than the danger of getting stuck at once in philology, the first stage.

A philosophically trained philosophy does justice within itself already to determinate thinking and thorough cognition, and its content, the universal of the spiritual and natural relations, leads of itself immediately to the positive sciences which show this content in concrete shape, in further exposition and application, so much that conversely the study of these sciences proves itself necessary for a thorough insight into philosophy; on the other hand the study of philology, once it has got into the detail which essentially is only to remain a means, has something so segregated and alien from the rest of the sciences that within it there lie only a slender bond and a few transition-points to a science and a profession of actuality.
zh: 哲学通过自身的规定性而更切近地获得那种可被学习的能力：唯有藉此，它才变得清楚、可传授，并且能够成为一份共同财富。
一方面它要求被专门地研究，而并不因为每个人原本都有理性就天然成为一份共同财富；另一方面，它那普遍的、可传授性又消去了它在新近时代于他人那里所获得的那副模样——若干先验头脑的怪癖；它由此而与它真正的地位相称，即在语文学这一为某种职业作准备的第一门学问之后而居于第二。
始终悬而未决的是：有些人会卡在这第二个阶段上，但至少不会是因为某些人那样的缘故——他们因为别的什么都没正经学到，便成了哲学家。
无论如何，那个危险似乎已不像我先前提到的那样大了；而且无论如何，它要小于在语文学这一第一阶段上就立刻卡住的危险。

一门在科学上训练出来的哲学，本身之内就已经使确定的思维与扎实的认识得到公正对待；而它的内容——精神关系与自然关系的普遍者——本身就立即引向那些实证科学，它们以具体形态、更进一步的阐述与应用来展示这一内容，其程度之深，以至于反过来，对这些学问的研究被证明是深入洞察哲学所必需的；相比之下，语文学的研究一旦钻进那本质上只应当作为手段的细节，就与其余诸门学问有某种如此分隔而陌生的东西，以至于在其中通向一门学问与一种现实中的职业的只有一条微弱的纽带和几个过渡点。

en: As a propaedeutic science, philosophy has above all to perform the formal training and exercise of thinking; this it can do only through a complete distance from the fantastic, through determinacy of concepts and a consistent methodical course; it must be able to afford that exercise in a higher measure than mathematics, because it has not, like mathematics, a sensible content.
zh: 作为一门预备科学，哲学尤其要完成思维的形式训练与操练；它只能通过完全远离幻想、通过概念的规定性和一贯的方法性进程来做到这一点；它必须能比数学提供更高程度的这种操练，因为它不像数学那样有一个感性的内容。

en: I mentioned before the edification which is often expected of philosophy; in my opinion it ought never to be edifying, even when it is delivered to the young people.
But it has a related need to satisfy, which I will still touch upon briefly.

For as much as modern times have again called forth the direction towards a solid subject-matter, higher ideas and religion, just as little as ever does the form of feeling, imagination, confused concepts suffice for it.

To vindicate the contentful for insight, to grasp it in determinate thoughts and to comprehend it, and thereby to preserve it from obscure byways, must be the business of philosophy. - With a view to this and to the content of philosophy in general, I will only mention the curious phenomenon that one philosopher delivers some sciences, more or less, or otherwise different ones, in the same lectures as another; the subject-matter, the spiritual and natural world, is always the same, and so philosophy too must fall into the same particular sciences.

That difference is probably to be ascribed above all to the confusion which does not allow it to come to determinate concepts and fixed differences; the embarrassment may also contribute its share when one is to deliver old logic alongside a newest transcendental philosophy, natural theology alongside a sceptical metaphysics.
I have already indicated that the old subject-matter indeed requires a thorough recasting and cannot merely be put aside.

Otherwise it is definite enough into which sciences philosophy must fall; the wholly abstract universal belongs to logic, together with everything which metaphysics formerly also comprehended; the concrete divides into the philosophy of nature, which gives only a part of the whole, and into the philosophy of spirit, to which besides psychology with anthropology the doctrine of right and duty, then aesthetics and the philosophy of religion belong; the history of philosophy comes in addition.
Whatever differences may exist in the principles, the nature of the object brings with it a division into the sciences named and their necessary treatment.
zh: 我先前提到了人们常常对哲学所期待的那种感化；依我之见，哲学即使讲给青年听，也绝不应是带感化作用的。
不过它有一个与此相关的需要要去满足，我还想简短地谈一下。
近代时代固然重新唤起了走向扎实材料、更高观念与宗教的方向，但为着这一点，感觉、幻想与混乱概念的形式却一如既往地远远不够。
为洞见而辩明那有内容的东西，把它纳入确定的思想并以概念加以把握，从而把它从晦暗的歧路上保全下来，这必须是哲学的职分。——关于这一点以及关于哲学内容本身，我只想再提一种奇怪的现象：一位哲学家在讲座中所讲的若干门学问——或多或少、或干脆是另外几门——与另一位所讲的并不相同；材料，即精神世界与自然世界，总归是同一个，因此哲学也必须分解为同样的一些特殊学问。
这一差异大概主要要归因于那种混乱——它使人达不到确定的概念与稳固的差别；当人们要在最新的先验哲学旁边讲旧逻辑学、在怀疑的形而上学旁边讲自然神学时，那种难为情大概也要添上一份。
我已经指出过，旧材料固然需要一番彻底的改造，而不能仅仅被搁置一旁。
否则，哲学必定分解为哪几门学问，是足够确定的：那完全抽象的普遍者归入逻辑学，连同从前形而上学也包含在其中的全部内容；具体者则分为自然哲学——它只给出整体的一部分——和精神哲学，后者除心理学（连同人类学）、法权学说与义务论之外，还包括美学与宗教哲学；此外还要加上哲学史。
原则上可能存在的种种差异如何，对象的本性却带来了向所说诸门学问的划分以及对这些学问的必要处理。

en: As for external arrangements for the support of the delivery, for example seminars, I refrain from adding anything, since I see with horror how prolix I have already become and how greatly I have taxed your indulgence; I add only the heartfelt wish for a happy continuation of your journey and the assurance of my distinguished esteem and devotion.
zh: 至于为支持讲授而作的外在安排，例如讨论课，我就不再多加什么了，因为我吃惊地发现自己已经变得多么啰嗦，又多么地耗用了您的宽容；我只再添上对您旅途顺利的衷心祝愿，以及我最诚挚的敬意与归附的保证。

August
